findings.evidence: Basic.lean:636-640; helper signature at Kinematics/Basic.lean:37-42 `(hf : W (f v) (f u) = W v u) (hfv : f v = v) (hfu : f u = -u) : W v u = 0`; `IsLorentzCovariant` at Basic.lean:550-551 gives `W (f v) (f w) = W v w`; mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Basic.lean:134 `theorem flip_apply (A) (x y) : flipHom A x y = A y x := rfl`. Contrast Basic.lean:584, where the sibling `IsProperLorentzCovariant.flip` does name the lemma before `exact`.
findings.fix: Add the mirrored helper next to `apply_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_neg` in Kinematics/Basic.lean (hypotheses `W (f u) (f v) = W u v`, `f u = -u`, `f v = v`, conclusion `W u v = 0`, same 3-line `rw ... ; linarith` proof) and apply it directly, dropping both the `flip` instantiation and the `rw`. Otherwise wrap the argument: `(by simp only [LinearMap.BilinForm.flip_apply]; exact hW _ hf u v)`.
findings.issue: With `(W := W.flip)`, `v := v`, `u := u`, the helper expects `W.flip ((reflect g u) v) ((reflect g u) u) = W.flip v u`, but the supplied term `hW _ hf u v` has type `W ((reflect g u) u) ((reflect g u) v) = W u v`; they match only by unfolding `flipHom`. The `rw [← LinearMap.BilinForm.flip_apply W v u]` at line 636 fixed the goal side only, so the proof still rests on an undocumented defeq.

findings.issue: `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners` repeats the same spectator-frame computations verbatim: the `g K.q (c₁ • e₁ + c₂ • e₂) = 0` block appears at 1087 and 1115 with an identical lemma list, the `pTransverse` version at 1089 and 1117, and the cross-term expansion of `g (· • e₁ + · • e₂) (· • e₁ + · • e₂)` three times at 1110-1112, 1120-1122 and 1128-1130. The reusable facts are hidden inside the proof.

summary: Two proof-quality issues remain: covariant_spectator_offDiagonal_zero still passes its invariance hypothesis through the BilinForm.flip definitional equality (only the goal side was made explicit), and SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners re-derives the same spectator-frame expansions with duplicated simp only blocks instead of a reusable SpectatorPair lemma.
